{{Quote|I'm Ovold, core-drilling engineer.|Ovold|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />}}
'''Ovold''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He worked on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] as part of the restoration effort and performed deep-core drilling operation to obtain the samples from the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] core; though the samples were in fact contraband Taris relics. He was supposed to provide the samples to [[Beryl Thorne]] as part of the contract, but his camp was ambushed by scavengers who stole valuable equipment as well as the samples. After Beryl's contact [[Voidhound]] arrived to collect the samples, Ovold had to direct the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] to the location the samples were taken instead. While on Taris, Ovold wore [[X-1 combat goggles]] at all time, keeping visual scanning for [[rakghoul]]s and other dangerous wildlife.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />
